$Comment: The Sawmill work station block. Shares its id with RpgStations' own jar default: this pack file overrides that ITEM wholesale via pack load order (the station's own StationAsset stays the jar's; this pack composes onto it additively through Extensions/SawmillProgression.json). This copy DELIBERATELY authors NO Recipe: the jar default is craftable at the Furniture bench standalone, and because an asset-pack override replaces the whole item, installing this pack removes that craftability - acquisition of the MMO-bridged sawmill is this pack's own concern, gated by load order alone. Model reuses the vanilla Lumbermill bench. BlockType.Seats is the seat hold mode's mount anchor (StationAsset.Hold.Mount, Surface Block); Offset stands the player back at working distance rather than seated inside the bench. Yaw 180: the engine adds a hard +180deg to the authored seat yaw (BlockMountPoint.computeRotationEuler; a chair's sitter faces AWAY from the block at authored 0), so 180 lands the worker facing the work surface.
